specName: Mermaid Editor UX and Workflow Clarity

FR-001.title: Empty canvas shows concise guidance for add, label and connect

FR-002.title: Empty-canvas hint names the three steps, no dismiss control

FR-003.title: Contextual guidance during connection and inline label editing

FR-004.title: Added node is selected and its label opens for inline editing

FR-005.title: Enter confirms inline label, Escape restores previous label

FR-006.title: Properties panel edits label and shows inline changes

FR-007.title: Connection prompt says choosing source or destination

FR-008.title: Active connection state shown by more than colour

FR-009.title: Escape cancels an unfinished connection, stated in prompt

FR-010.title: Connection direction and endpoints visible after creation

FR-011.title: Unselected, hovered, focused and selected states differ beyond colour

FR-012.title: Canvas and properties panel show the same selection

FR-013.title: Selected element type named in properties panel

FR-014.title: Element actions have full labels and appear only when relevant

FR-015.title: Diagram-level actions separate from element-level actions

FR-016.title: Unavailable actions disabled and announced as unavailable

FR-017.title: Toolbar grouped as History, Diagram editing, Export and sharing, View

FR-018.title: Less frequent actions move to secondary menu, none removed

FR-019.title: Copy Source, Copy for Markdown and Save file are distinct actions

FR-020.title: Preview shows Mermaid generated from current diagram

FR-021.title: Preview refreshes after each edit made while open

FR-022.title: Returning from preview keeps diagram, layout and undo history

FR-023.title: Preview and export explain node positions may not be kept

FR-024.title: No claim of exact layout preservation in exported Mermaid

FR-025.title: Generated Mermaid source remains inspectable and copyable

FR-026.title: Browser-saved, editable file and exported source distinguished in text

FR-027.title: Save used only for saving, Copy only for clipboard

FR-028.title: Unsaved changes shown when they exist

FR-029.title: Visible message when a save fails

FR-030.title: Saved never shown before save succeeds

FR-031.title: Diagram validity shown separately from save status

FR-032.title: Essential edits possible from keyboard without dragging

FR-033.title: Accessible names, visible focus, WCAG 2.2 AA contrast

FR-034.title: Panels usable at every supported viewport width

FR-035.title: New states work in Blueprint Studio and Light appearances

FR-036.title: Existing types, import, export, undo, persistence, shortcuts keep working

FR-037.title: No data loss when moving between editing and preview

FR-038.title: Mermaid generation semantics unchanged unless a defect is fixed

expectations: Replacing Mermaid as the diagram language
Preserving arbitrary canvas coordinates in exported Mermaid
New diagram types or new Mermaid syntax
Collaborative editing, accounts or cloud sync
context: area: app/rendering/shared (toolbar, properties panel, preview, save status, guidance)
constraint: setup.md AC2 to AC17 flowchart behaviour preserved
constraint: Mermaid generation semantics unchanged unless a defect is fixed
constraint: no new dependencies without a concrete requirement
constraint: Blueprint Studio and Light appearances both kept
intent: Make the Mermaid editor clearer for business analysts and developers: guided add-label-connect, clear selection and actions, toolbar grouped by intent, a Mermaid preview, and explicit save and validity status.

decisions.decision: Single pure Escape resolver in keyboard.ts: label edit, then connection, then selection
decisions.why: FR-009 two-step Escape; three listeners currently act on one press
decisions.rejected: Per-listener flags in FlowchartCanvas and useDrag

decisions.decision: Conditional actions disabled with aria-disabled and reason text, element actions shown only when relevant
Preview scope for sequence and C4 left as an open question, default extend only where a generator exists
decisions.why: Spec assumptions say shared, code opens preview for flowcharts only
decisions.rejected: Silent flowchart-only or silent all-types choice

decisions.decision: Properties panel shows only the actions that apply to the selection, with Reverse and Move disabled via aria-disabled plus a visible reason taken from validation
decisions.why: FR-014, FR-016; reasons come from the same check that refuses the operation
decisions.rejected: Always-shown buttons that explain a missing selection on click

decisions.decision: Layout-position note stays flowchart-only; sequence and C4 get the preview and Back to editing without it
decisions.why: BA decision 2026-10-24; their layout comes from order (FR-024)
decisions.rejected: Note for all three types as T050 was first written

decisions.decision: Narrow Tools panel puts Properties above the toolbox when something is selected
decisions.why: VO-050: the selected element’s actions were below the fold at 360 px
decisions.rejected: Scrolling the panel into view on open

decisions.decision: Button states get non-colour cues in the theme: hover underline, pressed inset ring, unavailable dashed border
Firefox dropped from the supported and tested browsers (constitution 3.0.0)
decisions.why: the Business Analyst asked to drop the Firefox tests; the constitution requires every supported browser to be tested

plan.summary: Plan, research, data model and UI contract written for oversized feature
plan.key_finding: Escape handling is split across three listeners and needs one resolver

tasks.summary: 60 tasks in 11 phases: Setup, Foundational (5 waves), US1 to US7, Sequence and C4 (9b), Polish; each phase in waves with join points

approach: Extend the existing editor in place. Put Escape order, save-unsaved derivation, toolbar grouping and icon names in pure app/editor modules, and render them in app/rendering/shared. Add one inline-SVG icon module and no dependency.

concerns.note: CRITICAL: constitution Principle V says controls MUST NOT be offered for unsupported actions, but FR-016, US2-AS4 and plan Key Decisions (disabled not hidden) offer disabled controls
HIGH: preview scope conflict. Clarification settles all three diagram types, plan Open Question 1 defaults to a narrower scope, research R5 says flowchart only, and T030-T032 cover flowchart only
HIGH: sequence and C4 editing UI has no tasks; Phase 3-9 files are flowchart-specific
HIGH: task ordering. T010 routes Escape through the resolver in Foundational, but canvas and drag Escape listeners are removed only in T016-T017 (US1), so one press still fires three listeners
HIGH: T030 tests the explanation beside Copy Source and Save file, but no implementation task adds it there
HIGH: FR-039 and SC-009 require the same icon in toolbar, panel and toolbox, but T022 (PropertiesPanel) does not use the shared icons
HIGH: no task renders getting-started help when nothing is selected (US2-AS1)
HIGH: constitution III is NON-NEGOTIABLE; T007 (strings) and T011 (Editor wiring) have no failing test task ahead of them
MEDIUM: plan and research R1 place the Escape resolver in keyboard.ts; T005 places it in escape.ts
MEDIUM: plan says SaveStatus gains an explicit unsaved state; data-model says it keeps five values and unsaved is derived
MEDIUM: Verification plan missing from plan.md; integrated-TDD checks not run
MEDIUM: tasks T032 still calls the sequence and C4 preview scope an open question, contradicting plan Open Question 1 and T056
MEDIUM: plan.md Project Structure omits Phase 9b files (sequence and c4 canvases, typeWording.ts); scale note still says about 40 tasks, now 59
MEDIUM: SC-005 keyboard-only coverage is not stated for sequence and C4; T039 names no diagram type
MEDIUM: plan.md has no Verification Plan; integrated-TDD plan and tasks checks not run

HIGH: FR-042 says icon-only only where the toolbar has no room, but room is never defined. VO-038, T028 and T031 cannot decide text versus icon at 360 px and wide widths. Plan Open Question 1 still needs the Business Analyst; the stated default is unconfirmed.

HIGH: Constitution 2.0.0 Principle V allows a conditional action to be shown disabled only with its unmet condition stated as text and announced as unavailable. FR-016 and VO-009 require disabled and announced but do not require the stated condition text. T023 mentions the reason, the obligation does not.

HIGH: FR-032 requires add, label, select, move, connect, delete, undo and redo from the keyboard. VO-019 expects only keyboard move. T042 tests the other actions but carries only VO-020 and VO-050, so no expected outcome verifies them.
MEDIUM: SC-005 and the Clarifications cover all three diagram types, but T042 names only flowchart keyboard-only files and Phase 9b has no keyboard-only task for sequence or C4.

MEDIUM: spec FR-017 lists four View items (Zoom in, Zoom out, Fit to view, Preview). contracts/ui-contract.md also places Mermaid source (show or hide) and Appearance under View. The spec and contract disagree on group membership.

MEDIUM: FR-046 requires shared toolbar icon size, button size, spacing and alignment. No obligation expects it. VO-027 covers state differences only, and T003 checks icon size only in a unit test of the icon module.

LOW: tasks.md line 3 cites plan.md Open Questions for the preview scope. plan.md Open Questions now lists only toolbar overflow. The preview scope is settled in spec Clarifications and research R5, so the cross-reference is stale.

LOW: tasks.md Wave 5 says one Escape press fires one listener from the start. T011 in Wave 4 routes Escape through the resolver while FlowchartCanvas and useDrag still handle Escape until T014 and T015 in Wave 5, so two listeners are active between waves.

LOW: the spec does not place Change type and Move to in a toolbar group. Only ui-contract places them under Diagram editing. Rename appears both as a diagram action in the toolbar and as a node action in the panel, which FR-015 separation makes easy to confuse.
Full e2e run (T058) was killed by Claude Code for low system memory; not re-run. Typecheck, lint and 1619 unit tests pass (#102-#104)
